name: Aakash Hongal
headline: Lead Data Scientist — 11 yrs across ML, generative AI, and marketing/healthcare analytics
_exclude_titles_note: Title-level knockout. These roles are categorically wrong regardless of how many skill keywords appear in the description - sales and presales postings routinely name Python/SQL/GCP without being technical roles.
_core_skills_note: Strong DS/ML signals used by the skills fallback. Deliberately EXCLUDES generic terms (Python, SQL, Git, GCP) which appear in postings across every function and carry almost no signal on their own.

work_authorization.note: Requires visa sponsorship. Postings that explicitly decline to sponsor are excluded in the deterministic pre-filter, before any model call - ineligibility is a fact, not a judgement.

domain_preference.note: Domain overlap is a SCORED dimension the agent must assess and state explicitly - not a knockout. Hard-gating on healthcare would exclude nearly every posting from the tracked companies, which are mostly fintech, infra and consumer.

strengths: Ships LLM/RAG systems to production, not just prototypes — with retrieval precision metrics, latency monitoring, and multi-LLM failover
Owns data science roadmaps end to end, from problem framing through delivery
Translates modeling work into measured revenue outcomes rather than offline metrics
Leads and mentors a small team of data scientists
Bridges data engineering and data science — builds the pipelines and dimensional models the modeling depends on

highlights.impact: Reliable, cost-controlled enterprise data discovery at scale

highlights.impact: Cut analyst execution time from hours to minutes, removing query bottlenecks across the marketing org

highlights.what: Designed and delivered a multi-dimensional B2B2C Marketing Intelligence DataMart, including ETL and dimensional models
highlights.impact: Enabled 3 revenue-generating use cases and supported $178M in sales activation

highlights.what: Used the B2B2C DataMart to validate and refine risk scores from a medical underwriting model
Built and deployed a GBM binary classifier to identify iOS device users, with ongoing monitoring and validation
highlights.impact: 40% lower campaign cost, 50% higher response rate

highlights.what: Deployed a GBM new-member acquisition propensity model trained on 500K+ records with batch inference and performance tracking
Implemented a Markov chain multi-touch attribution model and drove adoption over heuristic approaches
highlights.impact: More accurate marketing spend decisions for acquisition campaigns

education: MS, Business Analytics and Project Management — University of Connecticut
BE, Computer Science — Visvesvaraya Technological University
avoid: Pure frontend or web development roles
Pure data-analyst roles with no modeling component
Roles requiring deep systems/infrastructure engineering (Kubernetes, distributed systems internals)
notes: Strongest fit is senior/lead data science and applied ML roles, especially where generative AI and agent systems are moving into production. Deep experience productionizing LLM applications with real reliability engineering around them (failover, monitoring, evaluation), not just demos. Comfortable owning roadmaps and leading small teams. Healthcare and marketing analytics are the deepest domains, but the modeling and GenAI skills transfer broadly.
